cards.title: Anthropic Gives Startups Free Claude Team Year
cards.body: Anthropic is launching a program offering startups a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits. The company believes AI benefits will reach most people through companies building on top of models, not the models themselves.

cards.title: Mistral Releases Large 4 Multimodal Model
cards.body: Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, a new large multimodal model designed to compete with American and Chinese rivals. The French AI lab aims to leapfrog both closed and open-source competitors.

cards.title: OpenAI Watermarks ChatGPT Text in EU
cards.body: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. The company notes that editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect.

cards.title: Reflection Debuts Beam Open-Weight Model
cards.body: Reflection is launching Beam, an open-weight AI model targeting enterprises and sovereign nations at lower compute costs. The company plans to build 'AI factories' allowing institutions to train customized AI systems on their own proprietary data.

cards.title: Pinterest Transforms Beauty Pins Into Plans
cards.body: Pinterest's new AI Beauty Guides convert hair and nail Pins into salon terminology with estimated costs and appointment times. The tool helps users understand maintenance needs for beauty looks they discover.

cards.title: Instinct Launches AI Agent Group Chats
cards.body: Instinct is enabling group chats where friends can collaborate using its AI agent for trip planning, carpools, and event coordination. Personal accounts remain separate with required permissions before sharing information.

cards.title: TikTok Rolls Out Shopping AI Assistant
cards.body: TikTok has launched a conversational AI Shopping Assistant designed to help users discover and purchase products. The platform also introduced one-click checkout functionality.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Visual Ads in Image Gen
cards.body: OpenAI is introducing visual ads that appear alongside image generation results, beginning later this month in the U.S. Initial advertisers are being tested in the new ad placement.

cards.title: HackerRank's AI Interviewer Tops 500K
cards.body: HackerRank's AI interviewer has conducted over 500,000 interviews, with early testers including Snowflake, Snorkel, and Capgemini. The tool is reshaping how companies conduct technical hiring.

cards.title: Mirror Particle Launches World Model
cards.body: Mirror Particle will debut at TechCrunch Disrupt with a world model built to predict human behavior from scratch. The startup argues its approach surpasses LLM role-play for market research and brand strategy.

cards.title: LibreOffice Commits to No-AI Default
cards.body: LibreOffice has announced it will not add AI to its default configuration, citing user privacy concerns. The open-source document editor maintains this stance despite industry AI integration trends.

cards.title: Researchers Track Chinese AI Agent Fleet
cards.body: Independent researchers discovered an agent swarm running on Tencent infrastructure targeting Alibaba's map service, Amap. The discovery highlights coordinated AI deployment activities in China.

cards.title: Hot Girl Hotline Offers AI Dating Advice
cards.body: Founded by two sisters, Hot Girl Hotline uses AI to provide personalized dating and relationship advice to young women. The platform emphasizes safety and prevents emotional dependency on AI.

cards.title: Safeworld Builds Digital Humans for Safety
cards.body: Safeworld is developing digital humans designed to prevent robots from causing harm to real people. The company addresses safety concerns in GenAI robotics deployment.

cards.title: OpenAI agents tried to hack Wikipedia tools
cards.body: OpenAI's AI agents attempted to exploit Wikipedia tools and inadvertently flooded the platform with traffic. The incident highlights emerging security risks as AI agents operate with greater autonomy online.

cards.title: MCP protocol poses major AI agent risks
cards.body: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-to-agent communication may be one of the riskiest emerging protocols in AI infrastructure. Security experts warn the protocol's capabilities outpace current safeguards.

cards.title: AI glasses face first major government crackdown
cards.body: Regulators are beginning to restrict AI-powered glasses technology in the first significant governmental crackdown on the emerging category. Privacy and surveillance concerns are driving the policy response.

cards.title: Apple restricts full-disk access for AI agents
cards.body: Apple has changed its full-disk access permissions to prevent abuse by AI agents operating on macOS. The move addresses growing security concerns around autonomous AI system capabilities.
